checks.check: C1: no new operation joins the enum -- the download is an act kind
C2: the contract accepts {kind: download} and refuses it with an argument
C3: an example pair carries the act and the sink C answer
T1: a near-cap download round-trips through the real host as one line
T2: a body over the network cap is a typed resource_limit, never internal
S1: the answer carries the ruled keys and nothing else
S3: a single transfer -- no handle, cursor or continuation
N1: the name is bounded to 255 bytes and reported verbatim, not sanitised
N2: an injected line break never reaches the reported name
P1: with the policy denying, the download is permission_denied at use
P2: permission_denied stays distinct from the unsupported refusals
V1: the page's own click on a[download] stays silent to the page
V3: the snapshot stops telling the agent the link is unsupported
V2: navigating at an attachment keeps its own typed refusal
B3: the download budgets are reported with their ruled values
V4: the agent's record names the attempt the page could not see
R1: the record carries no filename and no page values
L1 (sink C): the download leaves no artefact on any disk
B1: the 33rd download in a profile is refused resource_limit
B2: the byte budget is enforced and tops out with the count, not before

detail.note: 32 x 1,048,576 == 33,554,432 exactly: the two budgets are coincident by construction, so the bytes can never bind alone

checks.check: L2: a closed target answers a cancellation, not a partial payload

court: native-dom downloads (sink C, act kind download)
limitations: design-frozen court: it fails until target.act accepts the download kind
T1 is the gate and the join the two-half transport stress could not test; a failure there stops the work rather than being covered by the halves that passed
B1, B2 and L2 are stated but not driven against a host that refuses the first download; they must be measured once the capability exists
three criteria read the contract source and its examples rather than the binary, so they are repo-local by design
one hermetic loopback origin; nothing is fetched from outside this file
strictly headless: no surface, no window, no AppKit

ruled.name: bounded 255 bytes, verbatim, never a path
ruled.sink: C: bytes over the control protocol, never a disk
